audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read 'Galio' for every row — the chart disagrees with itself. breakdown.cooldowns names Justice Punch as matchup-defining with no cooldown number (lint). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint). missingInteractions flags Pillar of Flame (W) denying Justice Punch (E, a dash), Colossal Smash's (P) auto-reset burst tell, and that Galio can cut Brand's retreat with E since Brand has no dash — none mentioned on the page.
audit.why: Justice Punch's real cooldown is 11/10/9/8/7s; enemyKit flags it as a dash, and ownerKit flags Brand's W as terrain that blocks dashes — so Pillar of Flame denies the leap when timed on the cast.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side moved to 'Galio' to match win[] and the packet (win unchanged, already correct — per the chart rule only side needed editing). Cooldowns field rewritten with the real number and the W-denies-E interaction. Dos/don'ts de-duplicated and folded in the Flash-for-the-wall-cut warning and shield-feeding note.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - E-Q stun package is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11/10/9/8/7s CD — his only dash-knockup; your W denies it if timed on the cast. - Colossal Smash (P) auto-resets his combo opener; the wind-up is your step-back cue. - The R opens or closes fights.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Hold Flash for his E wall-cut, not the damage — he has no other way to close the gap on you.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Q-poking into his up W (Shield of Durand) just feeds the shield — wait for it to break first.
